text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete styled outfit, photorealistic product catalog image, portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft studio light. Invisible hollow clothing with no person, body, skin or visible mannequin. Clothing: Fitted short-sleeve dark navy polo with crisp white pointed collar and white V placket, faded pale-blue extra-wide jeans, black white canvas low-top sneakers. No logo.  Accessories: One burgundy woven necktie with thin diagonal ivory and charcoal stripes, loosely knotted, full length visible. ; One burgundy leather blank card holder keychain with a small bronze key charm, no readable text. ; One silver double-drape trouser chain with small metal clip ends, no other objects. ; One dark brown almost-black leather belt with aged oval brass buckle, gently coiled.  All attachable accessories worn naturally on the ensemble at realistic scale. Unattachable tiny accessories arranged adjacent to the ensemble. Full uncropped framing, no text, logos or watermark.
